jobs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production 2D sidescrolling game environment atlas on TRUE TRANSPARENT background. Reference is style only. Exactly 8 separate large architecture cutouts in an evenly spaced 4 columns x 2 rows grid, no overlap, no labels. Each cell a whole charming crooked Halloween village building or small connected pair, full foundations and chimney visible, front three-quarter view with slight street perspective, consistent ground baseline. Row1: tall three-story plum timber inn with curved roof and orange awnings; two attached narrow crooked houses with lit bay windows; witchy pastry shop with round bay storefront and pumpkins; elaborate turreted corner town hall with clock and pennants. Row2: connected orange-plaster townhouse pair with stone steps; tall blue-roof apothecary with curved chimney; stone arch alley passage flanked by two small houses; close stone/timber house corner with climbing ivy. Make shapes taller and more whimsical, less realistic than reference, painted thick ink contours, softly textured masonry, purple slate and muted teal roofs, ochre plaster, warm amber lit windows and pumpkins, bunting. Dense charming village, varied silhouettes. No people, sky, landscape, ground rectangle or cast shadow tiles. Preserve transparent gutters at least 40px and padding. All 8 buildings fully in frame. Landscape atlas.

Use case: stylized-concept. One wide continuous hand-painted HALLOWEEN TOWN STREET background parallax layer, true transparent sky above rooftops, approximately 3:1 landscape. Reference image STYLE only. A densely inhabited magical medieval village: 12 overlapping crooked two/three-story timber houses, violet slate steep whimsical roofs, small turrets, bowed chimneys, amber glowing windows, ochre plaster and blue lavender stone walls, lamps, strings of tiny pumpkin lanterns and pennants. Houses form a coherent street terrace all firmly planted on their own continuous elevated stone sidewalk, stairs and retaining wall occupying lower quarter. Two narrow winding side alleys recede between houses into further rows of small rooftops: visible depth. View from sidescrolling game camera across the street at facades, slight perspective on building sides. No vanishing point down the main street, main street runs horizontally. Softer, less contrast than foreground, muted cool violet atmospheric depth with restrained warm amber window lights. Dense roofs fill most width, buildings overlap naturally, no giant gaps, no trees blocking them. Bottom border is opaque continuous dark violet stone retaining wall, top transparent irregular roof silhouette. No moon, sky rectangle, characters, text, borders or UI. Bold softly painted inked storybook artwork, detailed but not realistic. Complete scene strip not a sprite grid.

Use case: stylized-concept. Production texture for a 2D hand-painted sidescrolling Halloween village: wide horizontal repeatable street ground strip, approx 3:1 landscape, opaque edge-to-edge. Elevated camera seeing shallow depth of a broad walkable horizontal street. Top quarter a continuous narrow stone SIDEWALK made of neatly laid small slate cobbles and a low raised curved curb with occasional little tufts of autumn grass. Remaining street consists of medium smoothly worn rounded cobblestones, arranged in elegant gentle fan/circular paving patterns, subtle warm amber reflections from unseen lamps amid cool muted lavender-gray stone. Near bottom stones slightly larger. Ground perspective with clear pavement and curb, a little tidy moss in cracks, sparse small orange leaves. No dirt field, exposed cliffs, giant rough cracked rocks or piles of rubble. No houses, pumpkins, characters, props, light sources, text, sky or horizon. Matching storybook Halloween game, inked softly painted texture, readable understated background under colorful characters. No dramatic lights or glossy wet ground. Left and right edges align seamlessly, same curb height and stone scale. Fine details, medium-low contrast, keep entire image filled with pavement.

Use case: stylized-concept. Production sprite animation atlas on TRUE TRANSPARENT background. Reference is exact character identity: orange curly-haired cartoon zombie clown, orange and plum patchwork suit, cream ruff, white gloves, floppy jester hat, purple curled shoes. Same chunky proportions, illustrated ink outlines and painted shading. Exactly 4 columns x 4 rows, 16 evenly spaced separate cels with clear transparent gutters. All face LEFT, fixed size and anchored consistently. Rows1-2 (8 chronological cels): exaggerated magical shotgun defeat: startled squash with bulging eyes, recoils, edges become curling violet magical smoke, feet and legs dissolve into lavender puffs, suit disintegrates progressively into tiny confetti flecks and golden popcorn, head and glove fade into smoke, last two cels only swirling purple magic and a few sparkles. Last cel thin disappearing wisps. Row3 (4 cels): cartoon defeated clown TORSO AND HEAD ONLY with both arms and both legs absent, short clean ivory bone tips visible where limbs were, no blood. Four successive slapstick recoil/tumble poses in air: upright shocked, leaning backward, sideways tumbling, then sprawled on side. The detached limbs are NOT shown in these cells. Keep costume orange/plum robust and head same. Row4 (4 cels): violet-and-gold magical dust impact clouds, from sudden expanding poof to dispersing confetti and thin wisps. No red splatter, gore, flesh, wounds or horror realism. No backgrounds, frames, labels, floors, shadows rectangles, duplicate ghosts. Entire cel content within each grid cell. Upper animation uses progressive actual disappearance not same complete character covered with smoke. All pieces friendly Halloween cartoon.
